scope: Development evidence, not a publication receipt. Preserve failed attempts and require final-source regression and actual public-byte verification before declaring the upgrade live.
owner_request: Playable Quest 3 XR, with consideration for each tracked-controller button and a hand-tracking version.
preservation: Seven chapters, v1-v4 checkpoint compatibility, legacy mirror and chapter bank/backup keys, finite inventory, enemy difficulty, desktop Xbox presets, art and soundtrack. No sibling code is part of this upgrade. Grounded character motion was not present on the inspected baseline and is not claimed shipped.

retained_native_attempts.observed: Both sources entered actual immersive rendering and started the living Natatorium, but movement stayed disarmed. Hands rendered both 25-joint meshes. No captured JavaScript or shader errors.
retained_native_attempts.correction: Scene reconstruction was restarting the renderer's window animation loop alongside XR. Preserve the existing callback across scene replacements and ignore stale non-XR frames while immersive. The next native run demonstrates actual movement.

retained_native_attempts.observed: Controller and hand runs passed real movement, authored supply pickup, finite firing, exact reload and water entry. Each exposed surface-swim route then died to a living authored enemy. No JavaScript or shader errors were captured.
retained_native_attempts.correction: The route now chooses the public normal-speed option, dives before crossing the pool and postpones its test shot. It uses underwater cover and natural oxygen recovery rather than changing enemies, health or the game clock.

local_browser: Blocked by net::ERR_BLOCKED_BY_ADMINISTRATOR. No browser-policy bypass was attempted; native journeys execute through the authorized GitHub workflow.
test_device_boundary: Chromium/WebGL and game logic are real; XR sessions, headset poses, controller buttons and hand-joint poses are explicitly mocked. The journey writes device inputs only, with read-only route/layout guidance. This is not a physical Quest 3 or a human playtest.
open_physical_acceptance: Motion comfort and real tracking-loss/recenter recovery
Target-headset frame times and thermal behavior
release_gate: All permanent PR regression workflows on the final source, followed by safe merge, Pages delivery and release.py --published hash verification. Temporary integration scripts and their write-enabled workflow are removed before release.
